meta.name: roi-calculator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "calculate influencer ROI", "prove campaign value", or "what was our ROAS"; produces direct ROI/ROAS, earned media value, attribution-modeled revenue, LTV-based ROI, and a stakeholder-ready summary. Not for building the full slide/written report — use report-generator.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算网红营销的投资回报率与归因收入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需向团队或客户证明营销活动的实际价值。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate influencer ROI and attributed revenue for campaigns.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to prove the value of marketing campaigns to stakeholders.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的活动花费和结果数据，计算直接 ROI/ROAS、媒体价值、归因收入、基于客户终身价值的 ROI，并生成一份面向高层的摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求“计算网红活动 ROI”、“证明活动价值”或询问“我们的 ROAS 是多少”时触发。需要你提供花费和结果数据。

say.text: 用直接收入、媒体价值和 LTV 三种方法分别算 ROI。
say.note: Claude 会对比不同方法的结果。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can calculate direct ROI/ROAS, earned media value, attribution-modeled revenue, LTV-based ROI, and produce a stakeholder-ready summary based on campaign spend and results data you provide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "calculate influencer ROI", "prove campaign value", or "what was our ROAS". You need to supply spend and results data.

say_en.text: Calculate ROI for our influencer campaign: $25K spend, $72K revenue, 2.1M reach.
say_en.note: Claude will compute direct ROI, ROAS, and earned media value.

say_en.text: What's the ROI using direct revenue, EMV, and LTV-based methods?
say_en.note: Claude will compare results across methods.
